thread:
jordan: Heads-up — we're rolling a new Private metrics dashboard for on‑prem exports. Need concrete telemetry fields the agent can emit and any firewall/KMS/audit constraints to document for customers. cc @kai @rika

kai: Quick note — infra preference: agents should only need outbound HTTPS (443) to the control plane or go through customer proxy. No extra ports by default. If we require mTLS we'll need cert distribution docs.

rika: From runtime side we can emit: egress_bytes_total, export_attempts_total, last_export_success_ts, handshake_latency_ms, kvcache_hit_ratio, exported_model_version. We can attach tags: tenant_hash, agent_id, region. Agent can sign payloads with local KMS key id (kms_key_id). Need a rotation hook.

samir: Product wants per-tenant rollups + per-agent drilldown. Also need failed_export_reason enum (400/401/403/429/5xx) and a small last_payload_digest for triage. Dashboard should show export_rate and 95p latency.

nima: Security: do NOT emit raw customer identifiers. Use stable HMAC tenant_hash (HMAC with customer KMS) and include kms_key_id (identifier only). Audit hook must include event_id, signature, and minimal metadata to reconstruct the export event — no payloads with PII.

maria: UX thought — default dashboard should surface both site-wide and per-VPC views. Show quota utilization and a one-click “suggested mitigations” link for common failures (proxy auth, firewall). Add a canary toggle for rollout.

kai: Firewall specifics to document: outbound only to controlplane.redwood.example.com (443). Support proxy envs (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY). Handshake flavors: mTLS when customer provides cert; otherwise JWT signed by local KMS. We should include an agent_capabilities array in the handshake so control plane knows kvcache vs batching support. Example handshake payload: ```json {"agent_id":"agent-01","agent_capabilities":["kvcache","batching"],"kms_key_id":"projects/p/keys/abc"}```

jordan: Proposed telemetry API: POST /v1/onprem/telemetry with signed JSON body (agent signs entire payload). Sample: ```json {"agent_id":"...","tenant_hash":"...","metrics":{"egress_bytes_total":1234,"export_attempts_total":3},"sig":"BASE64SIG"}``` Would this fit infra constraints?

rika: Yes — fits. Runtime will produce delta counters for egress and include last_export_success_ts as a unix ms. We'll cap tagging cardinality to tenant_hash+agent_id only.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: featureflag onprem-metrics-pilot toggled -> 10% of agents in prod (rolled out 00:05 UTC). :rocket:

kai: Ops/additional constraints: cap payload to 512KB, prefer batching every 60s and max 1000 metric lines. Use delta counters to keep prometheus-compatible cardinality low. If customer proxy blocks, agent should fall back to buffered disk+retry and emit last_failed_reason tag.

samir: Canary checklist: compare handshake_latency_ms distribution vs baseline, monitor export_success_rate, and validate digest mismatch alerts. If anything >5% failure during canary, auto rollback.

jordan: Next steps — eng-infra to add a short firewall/proxy/KMS docs snippet + FQDN/IPs; runtime to publish the exact telemetry field names and signing scheme; security to approve KMS/audit event schema. I'll open a tracking issue: PRIV-2023 and add tasks. Ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
